responsibility: Declares the minimal public compiler interface for ThreadSanitizer support within GCC, currently exposing the file-finalization hook that emits module initialization for the TSan runtime. It serves as the companion header for tsan.cc rather than containing sanitizer policy or pass logic itself.
same_name_distinction: Minimal header companion to gcc/tsan.cc, exposing only the file-finalization entry point for TSan support. Unlike gcc/tsan.cc, it does not define the sanitizer pass or memory-access instrumentation machinery.
